topography.project_purpose: Umee is a decentralized lending protocol that enables users to supply and borrow assets across multiple blockchains. It focuses on cross-chain interoperability and capital efficiency.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol consists of a single product family with one proxy contract that handles all lending operations. No additional infrastructure contracts are identified.
